Rawdah ash-Sharifah One of the most blessed places (reservation via the Nusuk application). Masjid Quba The first mosque in Islam – praying here gives the reward of an 'Umrah. Masjid al-Qiblatayn Mosque of the Two Qiblas (change in prayer direction). Masjid al-Jumu'ah Site of the Prophet's ﷺ first Friday prayer. 🏔️ Historical sites Jabal Uhud Mountain of the Battle of Uhud and resting place of the martyrs. Al-Baqi' Cemetery Many of the Prophet's ﷺ companions are buried there. The Seven Mosques (Masajid Sab'a) Sites related to the Battle of the Trench (Khandaq). 🛍️ Other places Medina Date Market To buy Ajwa and other dates.
